feature_name: Secure tags for firewalls in ComputeClasses
summary: You can specify secure tags in ComputeClasses so GKE adds them to created nodes for firewall targeting.
extended_definition: You can specify secure tags in ComputeClasses so GKE adds them to created nodes for firewall targeting.

evidence_snippets: Each tag within the list must comply with RFC1035. resourceManagerTags object ( ResourceManagerTags ) Resource manager tag keys and values to be attached to the nodes for managing Compute Engine firewalls using Network Firewall Policies. nodeKubeletConfig object ( NodeKubeletConfig ) NodeKubeletConfig controls the defaults for autoprovisioned node-pools.
Tags are used to identify valid sources or targets for network firewalls and are specified by the client during cluster or node pool creation.
